tests.assertion: With identical starting state, aptitude, training, resources, and experience, changing between lawful exact, individual-lite, and aggregate-unit representation grants no development efficiency bonus.
A 1,000-person unit receives no development multiplier from representation size.
An elite instructor cannot provide full individualized training simultaneously beyond available instructional capacity.
Promotion transfers only qualified people and conserves total personnel.
A one-year or five-year skip settles training and experience but cannot promote an entire unit without individual qualification distribution.
A safe batch and equivalent fine-grained unchanged cycles produce materially equivalent development.
